GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Bit Slow Out .5 Lengths , Drifted Back last off tardy start 6 Lengths 1000m, started to work into the race widest from the 500m, Kept Coming last 200m and ran into minor placing # grabbed placing

Jumped awkwardly missing start 1 length and Settled Down 10 Lengths Two Wide , Made Some Ground to Turn then Hooked Out to 7.5 Lengths 3 Wide , hooked widest Straightening Up and Made Ground down the outside in Straight # slow out/back/fair
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly and then restrained shortly after the start.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped only fairly missing start 1.5 Lengths and Settled Down 6 Lengths on fence, Drifted Back to 7 Lengths turning, Held Up rounding turn then steered short of centre of track Straightening Up , Made Some Ground to the line # slowly away
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began only fairly. Was unable to improve approaching and rounding the home turn when held up on heels.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow out 1 length and Settled Down 5.5 Lengths Two Wide , Drifted Back to 6.5 Lengths Two Wide turning, Hooked Out Wide Straightening Up and Made Ground down centre of track # slow out/ran on ok
Jumped Ok Checked Settled Down last over-racing 8 Lengths 600m last 8 Lengths Hooked Out 3 Wide home turn 3rd last widest runner Straight run peaked 100m # back/wide/forgive
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Over-raced in the early and middle stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped awkwardly & Settled Down 7.5 Lengths Two Wide , Made Some Ground to 5 Lengths 3 Wide turning, couldn't come on in Straight # no real excuses
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly. Laid in for a short distance near the 450m.
Hung out when racing keen in the early and middle stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow out 1 length and Settled Down 5 Lengths on fence, railed to 4 Lengths turning, Hooked Out 3 Wide Straightening Up and moved to 2nd place in Straight while conceding an extra 2 Lengths to the winner # winner far too good
Jumped awkwardly & Settled Down last of four runners trailing only 4 lengths, made no ground to Turn then Made Some Ground along fence in Straight # no threat 3rd

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly and lost ground. Rdr reported after being slow to begin, gelding never travelled comfortably throughout and was disappointing-added performance was possibly attributed to the firmer track.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped well settled down 3 Wide no cover 4 Lengths (800m), cornered near last, was last Soon After & things didn't improve from there # wide/spent turn
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced wide without cover throughout. Near the 500m, bumped.
